text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm done with my cooldown! Time to
head to my
part-time job!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our scheduled training,
Ines Fujin
disappears like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I settle down to review the data I
collected today.
As I weigh up which
training routine would be
best for Ines to
do next...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature, could I ask you to accompany
me for
another three laps?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you just don't get tired, do you,
Ikuno? All
right! Let's do a little extra
training together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other Umamusume, having finished
their
usual training, have already started
on some
additional training of their own
volition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is far from an uncommon sight here
at Tracen
Academy, but you'd be
hard-pressed to find Ines
Fujin among
their number.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the way, Bright! Excellent
form! You've
got a good center of
balance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Yes, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume calmly catching her
breath is
Mejiro Bright, another member
of the prestigious
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. All those days I spent worrying
over my
progress seem like a distant
memory now. You
solve my problems so
effortlessly, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Training isn't just about
quantity—quality plays a
major part! You
have to train with a goal in mind!

...Though I'm just repeating what
Grandmother
told me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's spot on. Rather than lamenting the
lack of
time Ines Fujin spends training, I
need to focus on
raising the quality of
her training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recently, one of the senior trainers
recommended
me some bookstores and
sporting shops, so I
decide to spend the
week scouring them for
useful reference
materials.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, when I make it to the book
shop in
question, it turns out to be huge!
Just finding the
right section seems like
it's going to be tough.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
You're looking for racing magazines?
You'll find
them on the second floor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'm not the only one who's come
here
looking lost. I turn around to thank
the helpful
clerk, only to find...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Please follow me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything in particular you're
looking for,
feel free to ask a member of
our staff!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting! Here's your ramen!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, about our training regimen
for
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What's wrong?! I'm right here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, we have been
bumping
into each other a lot. Even at
my one-off
part-time gigs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I'd prefer them all to be
long-term,
since it's hard to know when
they'll post openings
for one-off jobs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But with long-term jobs, I can only take
them on
if they have a lot of flexibility,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'd be in a bind if my shifts
overlapped
with a race that I absolutely
wanted to enter,
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So my only long-term jobs right now are
the
ramen shop, convenience store, and
flyer-posting
gig. I owe my managers big
time for always letting
me alter my
schedule on short notice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she juggles those three jobs in
addition to
various short-term ones...
Surprised by how hectic
her life must be,
worry creeps into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that face! I bet you think I've been
failing my
classes, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you're that concerned, then how about
I prove
it to you? I make a pretty
dependable classmate,
if I do say so
myself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
These notes are straight up god-like,
Ines! No
cap! You high-key deserve an
award or
something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I see before me are
Daitaku
Helios and Mejiro Palmer, two
of Ines Fujin's
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't exaggerate! All I did was
lend you
my notebook. I'm glad it
helped, though. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It was totes easy to follow, for real! I,
like, finally
understand the stuff written
on the math
worksheets!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Class doesn't start for another five
minutes, Ines.
And the teacher's not
even here yet, so why not
take it easy?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I've got to cram in as much study as
I can. I
can't risk failing and having to
deal with make-up
exams.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all you're having for lunch,
Ines? And
why are you wearing your
tracksuit?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! But I had a big breakfast! The track
is
normally pretty empty during lunch
break, so I
thought I'd take the chance
to work on my form!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text: Welcome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After watching Ines Fujin go about her
day,
there's something I've realized.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh? Trainer, I didn't realize you still
wanted to
shadow me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I'm just teasing.
Boss, one
order of deluxe ramen!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text: Coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah—that's not on the house, by the
way. You
have to pay for it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so you're Fu's trainer! I see she's
really got
you under her thumb!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, well and truly!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's our Fu for you!
By the
way...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to hear your thoughts on Fu's
running.
Think she's got the stuff to win
in the Twinkle
Series?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, I'm actually good friends
with her
mom. She told me that Fu has
had to put up with
a lot.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Always helping with the housework and
looking
after her sisters while her mom
was in the hospital.
Right up through
middle school, everything she
did was
for her family.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Even now, she works part-time jobs so
that she
can send money back home to
help with the
family finances and pay for
her sisters'
after-school lessons.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Haha, she's something else, isn't she? I
wonder
how she's able to push herself
like that.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't hurt her to let up a little bit.
But no,
even for part-time jobs, she
learns the fastest and
works the hardest.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
She's got it tougher than other students,
but she
enjoys every day to the fullest.
Maybe it's
because she's in a place
where she can chase her
dream.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
So... What's your expert opinion? Think
she can
handle the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your patronage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I leave the ramen shop and take a
moment for
myself. The streets are alive
with the sounds of
swift footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's hang out a bit more before
heading
home! I wanna hit up some
karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You're still not tired?! Okay, but only
thirty
minutes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Great stuff today, Boss! See you next
time!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! I just wrapped things up at
the ramen
shop.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not done for the day yet. Next,
I've got a
shift at the convenience store!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I took as many shifts as I could
pack in
today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Starting tomorrow, I want to put all my
focus into
training for my debut race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that smile on her face, my desire
to work
hard and help her reach her
potential increases
tenfold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide that the least I can do is carry
her school
bag as I accompany her to the
convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you sure you're okay with that?
It's
pretty heavy, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well, if you insist...

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you got a shift today too, Ines?

Hey, who is—ohh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The girl looking me up and down is
likely one of
Ines Fujin's coworkers. As
her trainer, I decide it's
best to greet the
girl with a polite nod.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so you're into the gracious older
type, huh,
Ines? Don't let me get in your
way, then!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, ya know? Having someone carry
your bag
all the way to work? You may
as well be all over
each other!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ohh, I see now. Yeah, you're spot on.
This here
is my one-and-only partner
who brings me
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Or to put it in clearer terms, my trainer!

But you already knew that. Now stop
messing
around already!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I never would have imagined.
Well,
whatever. See you during your
shift.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah.
Hey, hurry up, Trainer! I'll
be late if you don't pick
up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin dashes off toward the
convenience
store, and I hurry after her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My heavy footsteps echo some distance
behind
hers. I look forward to the day
we can truly walk
side by side.
